title: 내 노른자 왜 자꾸 터져

cuts.scene: Kitchen. Wife stares in frustration at a broken egg yolk in a bowl on the counter. Husband is nearby, looking on nonchalantly.
Husband leans against the counter, a faint, dry smirk on his face. Wife glares at him.
Wife picks up a small, unfamiliar clay toy product from the counter, next to the egg bowl, looking confused.
Wife uses the clay toy product to separate another egg, successfully. Her expression changes to surprise.
Husband takes a sip from his coffee mug, his gaze still dryly on his wife's surprised face.
Guide character appears with a product card showing '계란 흰자 분리기' and stamps '글쎄' on it. Wife looks at the product, husband sips coffee.
Wife eyes a closed kitchen drawer speculatively, hand hovering near it. Husband watches her.
Kitchen. Husband turns slightly, giving a firm glance towards the drawer, stopping wife from opening it. Wife pouts slightly.

situation: 아침 계란 요리 중 노른자 터짐
